public_domain_references.web: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is Yahweh your God?” My eyes will see her. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.
public_domain_references.asv: Then mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her who said unto me, Where is Jehovah thy God? Mine eyes shall see [my desire] upon her; now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then [she that is] mine enemy shall see [it], and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
public_domain_references.brenton: And she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shall clothe herself with shame, who says, Where [is] the Lord thy God? mine eyes shall look upon her: now shall she be for trampling as mire in the ways.

pob.text: A day for building your walls—on that day the boundary will be far removed[a].

spob.text: There will be a day for building your walls. On that day, the boundary will be moved far away.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.
public_domain_references.web: A day to build your walls! In that day, he will extend your boundary.
public_domain_references.asv: A day for building thy walls! in that day shall the decree be far removed.
public_domain_references.kjv: [In] the day that thy walls are to be built, [in] that day shall the decree be far removed.
public_domain_references.brenton: [It is] the day of making of brick; that day shall be thine utter destruction, and that day shall utterly abolish thine ordinances.

pob.text: That day—they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt[a], and from Egypt to the River, from sea to sea[b], and from mountain to mountain.

spob.text: On that day, people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt.[a] They will come from Egypt to the River,[b] from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

public_domain_references.bsb: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
public_domain_references.web: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.
public_domain_references.asv: In that day shall they come unto thee from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and [from] mountain to mountain.
public_domain_references.kjv: [In] that day [also] he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and [from] the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and [from] mountain to mountain.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thy cities shall be levelled, and parted among the Assyrians; and thy strong cities shall be parted from Tyre to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

pob.text: But the land will become a desolation because of its inhabitants[b][a], because of the fruit of their deeds.

spob.text: But the land will become a devastated place because of the people who live there. This will be the fruit—the consequence—of what they have done.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the fruit of their deeds.
public_domain_references.web: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
public_domain_references.asv: Yet shall the land be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
public_domain_references.kjv: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the land shall be utterly desolate together with them that inhabit it, because of the fruit of their doings.

pob.text: Shepherd your people with your staff[a], the flock of your inheritance, dwelling alone in a forest in the midst of Carmel; let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in days of old.

spob.text: Shepherd your people with your staff—your flock, your inheritance. They live alone in a forest in the heart of Carmel.[a] Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as they did long ago.

public_domain_references.bsb: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
public_domain_references.web: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest. Let them feed in the middle of fertile pasture land, in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
public_domain_references.asv: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thy heritage, which dwell solitarily, in the forest in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily [in] the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed [in] Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
public_domain_references.brenton: Tend thy people with thy rod, the sheep of thine inheritance, those that inhabit by themselves the thicket in the midst of Carmel: they shall feed in the land of Basan, and in the land of Galaad, as in the days of old.

pob.text: As in the days when you came out from the land of Egypt[a], I will show him wondrous things.

spob.text: I will show him wonders, just as when you came out of Egypt.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.
public_domain_references.web: “As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”
public_domain_references.asv: As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt will I show unto them marvellous things.
public_domain_references.kjv: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous [things].
public_domain_references.brenton: And according to the days of thy departure out of Egypt shall ye see marvellous [things].

pob.text: Nations will see and be ashamed of all their might[a]; they will put their hand over their mouth[c][b]; their ears will become deaf.

spob.text: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their power.[a] They will put their hands over their mouths,[b] and their ears will become deaf.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.
public_domain_references.web: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.
public_domain_references.asv: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; they shall lay their hand upon their mouth; their ears shall be deaf.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay [their] hand upon [their] mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
public_domain_references.brenton: The nations shall see and be ashamed; and at all their might they shall lay their hands upon their mouth, their ears shall be deafened.

pob.text: They will lick the dust like a snake[a]; like crawling things of the earth they will come trembling out of their strongholds. To Yahweh our God they will turn in dread[d][c][b], and they will be afraid because of you.

spob.text: They will lick the dust like a snake. Like creatures that crawl on the ground, they will come trembling out of their strongholds. They will turn toward Yahweh our God in dread, and they will be afraid because of you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will crawl from their holes in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.
public_domain_references.web: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth, they will come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.
public_domain_references.asv: They shall lick the dust like a serpent; like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their close places; they shall come with fear unto Jehovah our God, and shall be afraid because of thee.
public_domain_references.kjv: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
public_domain_references.brenton: They shall lick the dust as serpents crawling on the earth, they shall be confounded in their holes; they shall be amazed at the Lord our God, and will be afraid of thee.

pob.text: Who is a God like you[a], bearing iniquity and passing over transgression for the remnant of his inheritance? He does not retain his anger forever[b], because he delights in steadfast love.

spob.text: Who is a God like you? You forgive wrongdoing and pass over rebellion for the remnant of your people—your own inheritance. You do not hold on to your anger forever, because you delight in steadfast love.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
public_domain_references.web: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
public_domain_references.asv: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth over the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in lovingkindness.
public_domain_references.kjv: Who [is] a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth [in] mercy.
public_domain_references.brenton: Who is a God like thee, cancelling iniquities, and passing over the sins of the remnant of his inheritance? and he has not kept his anger for a testimony, for he delights in mercy.

pob.text: He will again have compassion on us[a]; he will subdue our iniquities[b]. He will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

spob.text: Once again, he will show us compassion. He will conquer our wrongdoing. You will throw all their sins into the depths of the sea.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.
public_domain_references.web: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
public_domain_references.asv: He will again have compassion upon us; he will tread our iniquities under foot; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
public_domain_references.kjv: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
public_domain_references.brenton: He will return and have mercy upon us; he will sink our iniquities, and they shall be cast into the depths of the sea, [even] all our sins.

pob.text: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and steadfast love to Abraham, which you swore to our fathers from days of old.

spob.text: You will be faithful to Jacob and show steadfast love to Abraham. This is what you swore to our ancestors long ago.

public_domain_references.bsb: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.
public_domain_references.web: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
public_domain_references.asv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, [and] the lovingkindness to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, [and] the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
public_domain_references.brenton: He shall give blessings truly to Jacob, and mercy to Abraam, as thou swarest to our fathers, according to the former days.
